About Updental Academy

Education built around one habit: showing up every Sunday.

We're not another certificate mill. Updental Academy is a small, focused academy that runs one live webinar a week — practical, specialist-led, and small enough that your questions actually get answered.

Why "Sunday"?

Weekdays belong to your chair-side hours. Sunday evening is when practising dentists actually have the headspace to learn — so that's the only day we teach. One session, one topic, 3 hours. No sprawling multi-week courses to fall behind on.

01

Taught by practising specialists

Every speaker is actively treating patients — not a full-time lecturer reading slides. You get judgment calls, not just theory.

02

Watch live or on your own time

Register once, join the Sunday live session, and if you miss it, your access carries over to the recording in Past Webinars.

03

Priced per session, not per year

No annual subscription lock-in. Pay for the topics that matter to your practice, skip the ones that don't.
